topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: I walked up to the school, the red bricks and tall windows as reassuring as they were the day I first stepped through these doors. The playground was a buzz of youthful energy, a stark contrast to the quiet halls inside. I found myself at the classroom door, my heart beating a little faster. There, standing by the blackboard, was Mr. Thompson, his smile as warm and familiar as ever. I could hardly believe it as I watched him from the doorway. It's been decades since I last sat in his class, and here he is, teaching my child the very lessons that once shaped me. The circle felt complete, a echo of my past weaving into my child’s present.
